name: Lucerne Grand
tagline: Where your West Side story begins
developer: City Developments Limited (CDL Polaris Properties Pte Ltd)
thesis: Lakeside MRT one minute away. A supermarket and shops downstairs. 570 homes by CDL in five blocks beside Jurong Lake Gardens. Preview 18 September 2026, booking 3 October.
price_basis: The developer has not released prices. Sizes are from the ERA Project Marketing briefing deck of 22 August, run from $2,300 to $2,800 psf. The ERA kit puts the start at $2,3xx psf with most units below $2,700, and its starting quantums are in the first column. The $2,400 to $2,500 columns are where this launch is expected to open; the working number on this page is $2,500.

Lucerne Galleria: About 1,000 sqm of shops and restaurants at level 1
Sheltered walk to Lakeside MRT, one minute
Five blocks, 17 storeys: Blocks turned to the lake and the river
Views over Jurong Lake Gardens from about level 12
Club Lucerne: Clubhouse, lap pool and aqua lounge
Kids' splash pool and gourmet pavilion
Outdoor fitness, wellness garden and pets garden
Homes: Flexi study in the 3-bedroom Premium + Study
Specifications: Smart home and smart community systems
Schools within 1 km: Yuhua Secondary and River Valley High
Canadian International School and NTU nearby

evidence: deck-45
Private prices kept climbing. Lucerne Grand is in this market.
deck-46
The private market tells a different story.
deck-47
Land prices since 2023. Lucerne Grand's site went for $1,132 psf ppr in June 2025, near the bottom of this list. Land is the floor under the price, not a discount.
deck-48
Land bids bounced 25% from the 2024 low. The next Lakeside plot will be built on dearer land than Lucerne Grand.
deck-49
Why swap from a non-harmonised home to a harmonised one: new launch prices barely moved for two years while resale caught up. Sell high, buy low.
deck-50
Sell high to buy low. Resale prices are now higher than brand new.
deck-51
Penrith, 936 sqft, $2.53M brand new. Stirling Residences, 1,055 sqft, $2.80M resale. The same pair exists here: a Lake Grande 4-bedder against a new Lucerne Grand 3-bedroom Premium + Study.
deck-52
The same idea again. Resale quantums are above brand new.
deck-53
Seaside Residences, 1,130 sqft resale, $2.8M. Emerald of Katong, 1,023 sqft brand new, $2.73M. Sell high, buy low.
deck-54
The results of harmonisation are already showing in the numbers.
deck-55
Emerald of Katong bought $222k cheaper than a similar Tembusu Grand unit. If it later sells at the same price, that is a $700k gain. Lucerne Grand is the harmonised launch on Lakeside.
timeline: Progressive payments while the estate is built
Four years from purchase, Seller's Stamp Duty clears
Exit window, the next upgrader buys at brand-new-equivalent psf
sources: URA caveats via the JND vault, latest August 2026. HDB resale via data.gov.sg, four months to September 2026. Land bids compiled from URA and HDB tender awards. Project facts from the ERA Project Marketing agents briefing deck of 22 August 2026, the info deck of 10 August and the objection handling kit of 4 September 2026; unit mix and sizes are estimates subject to final survey. Justin Ngai's Lucerne Grand client deck, August 2026.
